name: Jungle Boots
body:
Source Sargava, the Lost Colony pg. 29
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd
Slot feet; Price 6,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
These soft leather boots grant the wearer the ability to move through normal undergrowth without hindrance as if she had the woodland stride ability.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, longstrider, woodland stride ability; Cost 3,000 gp
